Our core belief

Creativity is not art
without impact.

Design is not decoration. Branding is not a logo. Marketing is not noise. Every idea we ship has to move people emotionally and move the business forward.

What we operate by

Five values.
No buzzwords.

These are the rules we work by with clients. They’re the same rules we work by with each other — which is the part that matters if you’re thinking of joining.

  1. 01

    Clarity over complexity

    We strip away jargon, fluff, and over-engineering. Clarity builds trust. Trust accelerates growth.

    What that means for youYou’ll always know what you’re working on, why it matters, and how it’s measured.

  2. 02

    Creativity with purpose

    Bold ideas mean nothing without direction. We design to differentiate, not decorate.

    What that means for youYour ideas get judged on whether they work — not on who suggested them.

  3. 03

    Conversion is a responsibility

    Attention is expensive. We don’t waste it. If it doesn’t help convert, it doesn’t ship.

    What that means for youYou’ll see what your work actually did, in numbers, not just in a portfolio.

  4. 04

    Fresh thinking, always

    Stale ideas don’t scale. We challenge “this is how it’s always been done.”

    What that means for you“We’ve always done it this way” is not an answer anyone here has to accept.

  5. 05

    Partnership over vendor work

    We don’t work for clients. We work with them — as strategic partners and long-term allies.

    What that means for youYou’ll talk to the people you’re building for, not just to a brief.

What it’s like here

A small team,
a lot of surface area.

Nine people covering design, web, video, PPC and strategy. That means less handover and more ownership — you’ll see a project from the brief to the numbers it moved.

  • A hybrid model

    Days at the Nicosia office, days working from home.

  • Brands across industries

    The opportunity to work with brands across a variety of industries.

  • Hands-on from day one

    Involvement across digital strategy, content, campaigns and client relationships.

  • Specialists beside you

    Collaboration with specialists across design, video, PPC, web and digital marketing.

  • Real projects, not busywork

    Exposure to real client projects, from strategy through execution.

  • Room for your ideas

    Space to bring your own ideas to the table.

  • Room to grow

    Opportunities to develop your skills and grow within avocadots.

  • Ownership, not oversight

    A team where collaboration, ownership and fresh thinking are part of how we work.

How hiring works

Four steps.
No black box.

You’ll know where you stand at every stage, and you’ll hear back from us either way.

  1. 1

    Apply

    Send the form on the role page — CV, and a portfolio if the work is visual.

  2. 2

    We read it

    A person reads every application. You’ll hear back either way.

  3. 3

    A conversation

    A call with the people you’d work with. Bring questions.

  4. 4

    Meet the crew

    Come to the Nicosia office, meet the team, see how we actually work.
